name: Shop
description: An orders API, payments and a storefront in one monorepo, each a sector. The order JSON is their shared contract, so changes to it fly as crossings: they land in every sector at once, or in none.

sectors.name: Orders API
sectors.description: Builds the order JSON that payments and the storefront read.

sectors.name: Payments
sectors.description: Charges an order from the order JSON.

sectors.name: Storefront
sectors.description: Renders the receipt from the order JSON.

crossings.title: Rename the order total to totalCents
crossings.body: The order JSON calls its total `total`, which hides its unit. Rename the field to `totalCents` in the orders API's orderJson and, in the same change, in everything that reads it: payments' chargeRequest and the storefront's receiptLines, with the tests that name the field. The three sectors must switch together: a storefront that reads totalCents before the API sends it prints $NaN.

crossings.title: Put the currency in the order JSON
crossings.body: Add `currency: "usd"` to the order JSON from the orders API. Payments charges in the order's currency instead of its own hard-coded "usd", and the storefront formats money with the order's currency (USD shows $). Update the tests in all three sectors.
